description: This file defines an abstract base class for embedding packed parameters in quantized models, likely used within the ATen library of PyTorch. It declares virtual methods related to embedding bag operations with different bit-widths, unpacking, and retrieving metadata like bit rate and version.

classes.name: EmbeddingPackedParamsBase
classes.description: An abstract class defining interface for embedding packed parameter operations in quantized models, inheriting from torch::jit::CustomClassHolder.

methods.name: embeddingbag_byte
methods.description: Performs embedding bag operation with byte (8-bit) quantization.

methods.name: embeddingbag_4bit
methods.description: Performs embedding bag operation with 4-bit quantization.

methods.name: bit_rate
methods.description: Returns the bit rate used for quantization.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the embedding parameters.
